card.name: Commas between cross-referenced label sections
card.fires_on: The comma after a section number in a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.3), ... in drug label text. It sits right before the next section title.

modes.label: Comma in section list
modes.description: Comma after a parenthesized section number, before the next cited section name.
modes.example: [see Dosage and Administration (2.3)<< ,>> Warnings and Precautions (5

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens, which are mixed Chinese and code words; the pole mostly signals that another section title comes next.
card.plain: It marks the comma in a bracketed list of label sections, just before the next section name appears.
